jobs.description: Precision for Medicine, Oncology and Rare Disease is not your typical CRO. We are passionate about cultivating our culture and are proud to share extremely high retention rates compared to industry averages. We are now recruiting In-house CRA I/ In-house CRA II to join our team in Poland. Position summary The In-house CRA (IHCRA) provides centralized, non-site-facing support to CRAs and clinical project teams across the study lifecycle. The role supports consistent site oversight by maintaining study documentation and systems, reviewing and reconciling site-level data, preparing operational metrics, and completing agreed administrative follow-up activities. The IHCRA works in close collaboration with assigned CRAs and under the oversight of the CTM, escalating issues that require site-facing follow-up or clinical judgment. This is a regional support role. Direct communication with investigator sites and travel to site visits are not part of the core scope. The role may support studies across European countries and therefore does not require a local language for each supported country. Essential functions Provide non-site-facing operational and administrative support to assigned CRAs and clinical project teams throughout the study lifecycle. Prepare and maintain Investigator Site Files, including document distribution and coordination with shipping vendors where required. Route site communication and follow-up to the assigned CRA. Where an electronic Investigator Site File is implemented, review it remotely for completeness and identify documents requiring CRA follow-up or filing in the Trial Master File. Review documents received from CRAs and CTMs for legibility, completeness, correct orientation and filing readiness, and file documents in the eTMF in accordance with applicable processes. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years. To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund. You will work directly with end users to understand how care is delivered in practice, and then translate those workflows into effective Heidi usage. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing healthcare organisation, working alongside a multidisciplinary team of experienced clinicians who share a passion for improving patient outcomes. With a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management and comprehensive specialist training, we are keen to hear from consultants who are open to exploring new approaches to patient care and want to make a meaningful difference in an evolving area of medicine. Previous chronic pain experience is not essential. What matters is a genuine interest in learning, an open-minded approach to alternative treatment options and a commitment to delivering excellent patient care. What is the job? As a Consultant Anaesthetist at Montu, the role focuses on assessing and supporting patients living with chronic pain who may have exhausted conventional treatment options. Working within our Alternaleaf clinic, consultants play a central role in determining the suitability of cannabis-based prescription medicines (CBPMs), developing individualised treatment plans and supporting patients throughout their treatment journey. jobs.title: Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d)
jobs.description: About Recare As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system. What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d): German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result. You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing. Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably. Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design. Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later.
